title: ffsubsync + pysubs2 integration contract: sync-then-validate shell adapter
purpose: Concrete integration contract showing how to pipe ffsubsync's output SRT into pysubs2 for post-sync validation and format conversion. Demonstrates the interface boundary, preconditions, and failure-handling assumptions documented in art_01M6N3Y4A4RTHK7PKXE3ZWES7K r2 and art_01M6M7RTZQAYHCT8C265GC68C9 r2. Nothing is installed or run; this is a source sample.
